overflowingbars.tooltip.health_allow_lay: Add layers to this bar. When disabled any modifications to the bar from this mod will be turned off.
overflowingbars.tooltip.health_allow_cou: Render row count to indicate total amount of rows since not all may be visible at once due to the stacked rendering.
overflowingbars.tooltip.health_colorize_: Show colorful icons on the front row, not just on all subsequent rows.
overflowingbars.tooltip.health_inverse_c: Use vanilla's icons on all front rows, use custom colored icons on the background row.
overflowingbars.tooltip.health_row_shift: Shift the bar up or down by specified number of icon rows. Allows for better mod compatibility.

overflowingbars.tooltip.armor_move_chat: Move chat messages above armor / absorption bar.
overflowingbars.tooltip.toughness_bar: Render a separate armor bar for the armor toughness attribute (from diamond and netherite armor). Having only this option active will make the toughness bar behave just like vanilla's armor bar without any colorful stacking or so.
overflowingbars.tooltip.toughness_left_s: Render the toughness bar on the left side above the hotbar (where health and armor is rendered).
overflowingbars.tooltip.count_force_font: Force drawing row count using the font renderer, will make numbers display larger.
overflowingbars.tooltip.count_full_rows_: Only include completely filled rows for the row count.
overflowingbars.tooltip.count_always: Show row count also when only one row is present.
overflowingbars.tooltip.count_x: Render an 'x' together with the row count number.
